published_statement: Gao & Wald 2000 p.7 (READ): 'if we define the matrix A^mu_nu(lambda) ... by d^2A^mu_nu/dlambda^2 = -Sum R_{alpha beta sigma}^mu k^alpha k^sigma A^beta_nu (11) with initial conditions A|_p = 0 and dA/dlambda|_p = delta, then q will be conjugate to p if and only if det A = 0 at q. We define G(lambda) = sqrt(det A(lambda)) (12) ... the Raychaudhuri equation yields G''/G = -(1/2)[sigma_ab sigma^ab + R_ab k^a k^b] (13) where sigma_ab denotes the shear of the congruence of null geodesics emanating from p.' Kar & SenGupta p.13 eq (17): 'dTheta/dlambda + (1/2)Theta^2 + sigma^2 - omega^2 = -R_ab k^a k^b', attributed to Sachs 1961. Olum 1998: 'The generic condition holds whenever there is any normal matter or any transverse tidal force anywhere on P ... From the generic condition, sigma cannot vanish everywhere, thus WEC implies theta < 0.' Gao & Wald p.9: 'Since M is null geodesically complete and satisfies the null energy condition and null generic condition, it follows that every null geodesic in M contains a pair of conjugate points [9].' Sachs's shear equation (sigma' = -theta sigma - Psi_0, i.e. traceless tidal = Weyl) is NOT read here; it is re-derived (S1b).
published_hypotheses: affinely parametrised null geodesic congruence (Kar-SenGupta p.13; Gao-Wald eq 11)
twist-free congruence: omega = 0, true for the congruence emanating from a point p (Gao-Wald 'emanating from p'; A(0)=0, A'(0)=I)
conjugate point defined by det A = 0 of the Jacobi matrix (Gao-Wald p.7)

eq (13) is an identity (no energy condition); the FOCUSING-TO-CONJUGATE-POINT conclusions that use the shear term are stated under NEC/WEC plus the generic condition plus completeness (Gao-Wald p.9 citing Hawking-Ellis; Olum 1998 uses WEC)
Weyl sources shear: read only in the timelike analogue (Kar-SenGupta eq 13, Ellis-van Elst eq 31) and via Olum's 'transverse tidal force' clause; the null version re-derived here (S1b, S3)
hypothesis_drift: WIDENED (seatindex.py:55-56 'Weyl is traceless and focuses one eigendirection whatever q does'): true of the Weyl CONTRIBUTION, which is q-independent (S1b, S4); NOT true of the conjugate point. With Ricci trace 2q and Weyl eigenvalues +-w the tidal eigenvalues are q+-w; q <= -|w| leaves no focusing eigenvalue (z3 sat, S5a) and at the tree's own parameters (b=0.3, x0=-40, M=-2e-3) q=-|w| removes the conjugate point (S5b) while q=-|w|/2 only delays it to 92.0 (thin-lens 91.4, S5c). The restatements read here (Olum 1998, Gao-Wald p.9) couple shear focusing with WEC/NEC; the tree's phrase drops that hypothesis. In vacuum (q=0), the only case seatindex:50-56 and :172,:183-185 actually rest on, no drift.

rederivation.outcome: 24/24 PASS (sympy + z3 5.1.0 + numeric; output in rederive/sachs-weyl-shear-focusing.out). S1: from A''=-TA with symmetric B=A'A^-1, theta'=-theta^2/2-tr sigma^2-tr T and sigma'=-theta sigma-(traceless T) exactly (Sachs's optical equations; tr sigma^2=(a-d)^2/2+2c^2>=0). S2: Jacobi formula and Gao-Wald eq 13 G''/G=-(1/2)[sigma_ab sigma^ab+R_kk] exactly; the tree's u''=-qu, q=4piT_kk=R_kk/2, is eq 13 with sigma dropped. S3: exact Schwarzschild, equatorial null geodesic: R_kk=0, screen tidal T=diag(3ML^2/r^5, -3ML^2/r^5), T12=0 -- traceless, linear in M, sign of M swaps the focusing eigendirection. S4: z3 unsat for a traceless nonzero T with no positive eigenvalue (vacuity guard sat without tracelessness). S5: z3 sat for w!=0, q<=-|w| (no focusing eigenvalue); numeric q=-|w| kills the conjugate point, q=-|w|/2 delays it to 92.0. S6: Born Jacobi reproduces the tree's 55.16/56.52/47.17 to <=1.3%. S7: linearised metric R_kk=0 at O(M), O(M^2) residue defocusing, -6.5e-4 of Weyl power; composite's static trace check uses a non-null k. First run: S5c FAILED because the check was mis-specified (L=75 < thin-lens focus 91.4); corrected to L=150 and a thin-lens target, noted in the script.

lacked_data: Nothing the conclusion uses is a datum: Sachs 1961 and Gao-Wald eq 13 are identities of the geodesic-deviation (Jacobi) equation, re-derived exactly here (S1, S2), and the Weyl-traceless, sign-blind property is an algebraic fact checked exactly on Schwarzschild for either sign of M (S3) and by z3 for any traceless symmetric 2x2 (S4). There is therefore no later measurement that could move it, and M's hypothesis finds nothing to act on for THIS result: evidence against a data gap is that the statement holds symbolically with no numerical input. What the physicists of 1961-2000 did not address -- and the tree does -- is the NEC-violating regime; the standard theorems that turn shear focusing into conjugate points (Hawking-Ellis via Gao-Wald p.9; Olum) assume NEC/WEC. That is a scope boundary, not missing data, and computing across it (S5) shows the scope matters: with Ricci defocusing q <= -|w|, Weyl's sign-blind focusing yields no conjugate point. Negative mass itself is unobserved; the tree prescribes it (composite.py:104-106 list item 1), and the result holds for negative-mass Schwarzschild as a vacuum metric regardless.
grade_evidence: In vacuum every use STANDS: eq 13 and the Sachs equations re-derived exactly (S1-S2), Schwarzschild tidal T=3ML^2/r^5 diag(1,-1) exactly traceless and sign-blind (S3-S4), and the tree's vacuum counterexample (conjugate point with R_kk=0 at 56.50/47.17) reproduced independently to 1.3% by Born integration (S6); so seatindex.py:41-60,169-185 (the Lyapunov strike, lyapunov_excludes_weyl()=False) and anecscope.py:59-72,206-211 (lemma_is_shear_free_only) rest on firm ground. NARROWED because two uses carry the statement past its hypothesis: seatindex.py:55-56 'whatever q does' and anecscope.py:96-100/252-258 one_object_produces_both() (hard-coded True) apply sign-blind Weyl focusing where T_kk<0, outside the NEC/WEC under which the read restatements (Olum 1998; Gao-Wald p.9) draw conjugate points from shear; computed here, q<=-|w| leaves no focusing eigenvalue (z3 sat) and removes the conjugate point at the tree's own parameters (S5b). This narrows a phrase and a constant, not a measurement: anecscope's per-ray conjugate points are measured by the full matrix and stand as measurements. Two discrepancies recorded, neither moving the conclusion: the linearised metric's O(M^2) R_kk (not 'exactly 0'; defocusing, 6.5e-4 of the Weyl power) and composite.py's static trace check with a non-null k (S7c-S7d). Not WRONG: no counterexample to the external result exists here; the counterexample is to the widened reading only.
what_would_change_the_grade: To STANDS: the tree restricting the two widened sites to 'Weyl's contribution is q-independent; a conjugate point needs it to beat Ricci defocusing' (or an in-tree computation showing the ANEC-violating rays' Weyl eigenvalue dominates q along each ray, replacing the constant True). Reading Sachs 1961 itself, or a restatement of the null shear equation sigma'=-theta sigma-Psi_0, would upgrade read_status from READ-VIA-RESTATEMENT; the re-derivation S1b already fixes its content. To WRONG: only an exhibited error in the Jacobi decomposition itself, which S1-S3 exclude symbolically.
